title: Establish per-model FP8/INT8 baseline profiles + CI calibration harness
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Produce validated, per-model recommended quantization defaults (FP8/INT8) surfaced in the model catalog with automated calibration and CI validation so customers can safely opt-in to lower-cost profiles. Deliverables: 1) canonical baseline profiles (FP8, INT8 symmetric/asymmetric) for each catalog model with metadata on expected token-quality delta and latency/cost delta; 2) a reproducible calibration workflow and artifacts (calibration dataset, calibration recipe, synthetic prompts) that produce calibration signatures; 3) an accuracy validation harness integrated into our model onboarding CI that runs regression tests and outputs pass/fail and numeric deltas; 4) rollout guardrails and automated fallback rules when a profile violates quality thresholds in production.
acceptance_criteria: Per-model default profile added to model-catalog metadata for at least 12 production models (open+verified)
Calibration workflow codified as a reproducible pipeline (data, seed, steps) and stored in s3://redwood-quant/artifacts/ENG-85234/
CI job (quant-calibration-check) runs on PRs to model-onboarding and fails if accuracy drop > 2% on task-specific evals
Dashboard in Console shows per-model token-level latency and unit-cost delta for selected profile vs float baseline
Rollout policy auto-assigns fallback (float/safer quant) if live A/B shows degradation beyond thresholds for 30m
tasks: Assemble calibration datasets for evaluation slices (common web prompts, instruction-following, code generation)
Implement calibration binary and recipe runner in infra/quant/ with reproducible seeds and deterministic ops
Create evaluation suite: BLEU/ROUGE/EM/perplexity + Redwood task-level scoring harness for instruction tasks
Extend model-catalog schema to include recommended_profile, expected_quality_delta_pct, calibration_artifact_link
Add CI job and gating rule to model-onboarding pipeline with clear failure signal and remediation notes
Prototype web Console widget showing profile impact (latency/cost/quality) and rollout controls
